span.p: Unwrapped transient failure or invalid payload

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Select from current feasible plans
Ready-work: deduplicate and rank evidence
Rebuild selection state each decision

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Deterministic policy, or hybrid ready-work
with one distinct plan and healthy provider?

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Facts, goal and last eight history events
Include scheduling evidence when available
Omit raw transfer receipts and connector lists

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Offer up to 16 plans plus observe
One choice and, for each plan:
benefit 0–2, disruption 0–2,
missing-start-evidence value 0–1

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Serialized state + questions fit budget?
Default: 32,000 UTF-8 bytes

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Drop final candidate and rebuild
Byte bound is not a token estimate

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
HTTP provider circuit admits a call?
Cooldown, exhaustion and interrupted requests
retain their durable incident budget

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist request reservation when configured
Call client once for the entire batch
HTTP clients use a 10-second timeout

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Record provider hold; keep observing
No hybrid fallback or stall-budget charge
No sleep inside provider evaluation

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
HTTP failure budgets: auth or quota: 3;
network or rate limit: 8; schema: 1
Interrupted healthy request exhausts at one
Backoff and bounded Retry-After; persist budget

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Exact question keys and answer types?
Finite values, complete distributions,
matching rubrics and consistent choice/scores?
Respect supported provider rounding

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Model chose observe
or choice confidence below floor?
Default floor: 0.45

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Exclude candidates needing evidence ≥ 0.5
or benefit/disruption confidence below floor

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rank eligible offered plans:
choice probability + benefit / 4
− disruption / 8 − 0.02 per step
A heuristic, not success probability

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Select maximum-utility plan
It can differ from the choice label

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
No usable model decision
Retain reason and rejection diagnostics

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Ready-work: first available evidence-ranked plan
Otherwise: fewest steps, then plan ID
Uses feasible plans before model-byte pruning

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Strict Jev: observe without mutation
Increment stalled-decision count

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Configured stall limit reached?
Default: four decisions

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Save checkpoint; append configured logs
Publish truthful status, decisions and evidence

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Unhandled controller, persistence
or backend failure

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Commit selected plan and step index
Persist any capital or successor intent

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Mark blocked
Retain exact reason and failure history
